jobs.occupation: Internship – Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), Energy Transfer &
jobs.description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company with 12 million customers and approximately 21,000 employees. We are convinced that there is a way to build a future in which everyone can choose fossil-free ways to transport, produce, and live.

Job Description

Are you a student looking to apply your knowledge to real-world solutions that support the energy transition? With us, you'll have the opportunity to complete your internship close to the business, working alongside experienced specialists and tackling challenges where your ideas and perspectives can make a real difference.
About the internship
As an intern, you will join the Energy Transfer & Environment group within Vattenfall R&D Laboratories, working alongside specialists in fluid mechanics and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD). Our work includes numerical flow modelling and experimental measurements for energy applications, including hydropower and nuclear power.
During the internship, you will work with CFD on a defined fluid-mechanics problem relevant to the group’s ongoing activities. Proposed tasks include preparing simulation models and computational meshes, setting up and running simulations, evaluating flow behaviour, and comparing results with available experimental data or reference cases, where applicable. The specific application and simulation tools will be agreed with the supervisor.
The aim of the internship is to develop practical skills in CFD and contribute to the understanding of an energy-related flow problem. You will document modelling assumptions, assess the quality and limitations of the results, and present your findings in a technical report and a final presentation to the group.
Duration: Five months, full-time.This internship is for two students. 

Qualifications

We are looking for students who are currently enrolled in ongoing studies and are eager to put their knowledge into practice through an internship at Vattenfall. You are also someone who identifies with our principles: Active, Open, Positive, and Safety. In addition, we expect you to meet the following requirements:
Education: Ongoing university studies in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Energy Engineering or a related discipline, preferably with coursework in fluid mechanics, numerical methods and CFD.
Previous experience with a CFD solver and programming or data analysis is an advantage.
Language skills: Good command of English, both spoken and written, for technical discussions, documentation and presentations.
Availability: Able to undertake a five-month internship as part of your ongoing studies.

Additional Information
Start of assignment: By agreement.
Location: Solna. 
Application – a document with your CV.
Application deadline: 2026-11-30.
Contact person and proposed supervisor at Vattenfall: Eric Lillberg, Senior Principal R&D Engineer, Fluid Mechanics/CFD, eric.lillberg@vattenfall.com, +46 70 537 29 94.

Diversity and Inclusion – In Everything We Do
At Vattenfall, we value being Active, Positive, Open, and Safety-conscious. We are looking for employees who share our vision and can contribute to strengthening our company culture. We believe that diversity helps build a more successful and attractive company, and we strive to be role models in diversity and inclusion. Vattenfall actively works to ensure that all employees have equal opportunities and rights, regardless of age, ethnic or cultural background, gender identity, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or disability. Read more about how we work with diversity and inclusion here.
Vattenfall is part of Sweden’s critical infrastructure, and therefore many of our positions are security-classified. If this position is security-classified, a security screening will be conducted prior to employment in accordance with the Swedish Security Protection Act.
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

We are looking to expand our EATS´ team with a Calibration Engineer to work within Engine Controls & Diagnostics.
Job description:
You will work in a team responsible for securing that the engine fulfils the emission legislation, by developing and calibrating its own inhouse software models. The team consists of calibration engineers and function developers. You & the team will calibrate start and catalyst heating, emission control and purge control. The team delivers engine software to combustion engines in both mild hybrid and hybrid applications. 
From an early stage you will be involved in the development of new powertrain concepts and its software, where the team has the responsibility for vehicle emissions, and develop solutions that meet both legal requirements and give the customer an outstanding product. 
Early in the projects you will  be collecting data from the engine test rigs, in order to calibrate the software-models. Validation and later, final verification are always performed in cars or what the application is suited for. The job variety is huge and the need for further development is always there, which provides an interesting research atmosphere.
What you will do:
You will work in a team with experienced engineers but have a clear area of responsibility. Your main tasks will be to calibrate emission-related functions. 
The team is doing a large amount of our work in different engine test cells located in the laboratory, but also in vehicles on site and during expeditions to find extreme climates and altitudes. You will use advanced programs for modelling and data processing for best results.
﻿Main tasks:
Plan and develop methods of the calibration process.
Define and handle requirements within the system and from other areas.
Deliver calibration and verification of emission related functions.
Verify calibration in rigs and cars in different environments.
Evaluation and problem analysis.

 
Is this you?
To enjoy and succeed in the role, we see that you have a great interest in the latest technology, and you have an interest in powertrain controls and calibration. You also like to dig into a huge amount of data. You are a positive and self-driven person, who strives to see "the big picture" to be able to contribute in the best way. You appreciate being a part of a team and are a good communicator. Further, you are always curious, and love to solve problems in a pragmatic way!
 Skill requirements
Qualifications:
•	We believe you have a Bachelor’s or Master’s in the field of Mechanical, Physics, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent You have a passion for cars and internal combustion engines.
•	Fluent in Matlab/Python/Simulink
•	Fluent in English (written and spoken)
•	Driver’s license (Swedish B-level, passenger car)
•	Fluent in Swedish (written and spoken) is a plus
•	Good knowledge of internal combustion engines
•	Passion for vehicles and powertrains
•	Theoretical courses in combustion engines, software programming and electronics
•	Experience in ETAS INCA software
﻿Personal qualities
•	Self-driven with a positive attitude
•	Strong analytical skills as well as being able to execute tests “hands-on”
•	You plan, conduct, summarize and report your work in a structured and thorough manner
•	A curious and problemsolving mindset
• You can easily communicate and collaborate
• A true teamplayer open and supportive
This is a fantastic opportunity to contribute to advanced engine development while being part of a collaborative and supportive team.
You need to be living in Sweden and be able to work 100% onsite in Gothenburg.
Looking forward to meeting you!

has a valid working permit

A part- time contract from 50 % 
Training in home cleaning 
Collective agreement
Paid travel time between customers
Exercises benefit
Steady schedule that locks 7 days prior

Send in your application today - We employ on an ongoing basis!
We are looking forward to meeting you!
Team Freska

jobs.occupation: Java Developer (AWS & Azure) - Consultant Assignment in Gothenburg
jobs.description:
About the assignment
We are currently looking for a Java Developer with Azure and AWS experience for an exciting consultant assignment at WirelessCar in Gothenburg. You will work closely with experienced engineers and other technical roles in an international environment.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building software, working with cloud technologies, and ensuring services run reliably in production. You will join a high-performing team responsible for developing, deploying, and operating cloud-based connected vehicle services for a global automotive customer.
As part of the team, you will work across the full lifecycle of the solution, from software development and deployment to monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. The role combines backend development with cloud operations, automation, and production support, offering a great opportunity to work with modern cloud-native technologies in a collaborative and international environment.
Your main responsibilities
Develop and maintain backend services and supporting components in a cloud-native environment

Take an active role in operating production services, ensuring high availability, reliability, and performance

Monitor and troubleshoot production systems and participate in incident investigation and resolution

Improve observability through logging, metrics, monitoring, and alerting

Automate operational tasks and continuously improve deployment and operational processes

Contribute to root cause analysis and implement preventive measures to avoid recurring incidents

Collaborate closely with developers, architects, QA engineers and other stakeholders to continuously improve the service

Take ownership of technical challenges from identification through resolution

We are looking for
We are looking for a Java developer who enjoys working across both development and operations. While you do not need to be a dedicated operations specialist, you should be comfortable taking ownership of production environments, troubleshooting issues, and driving continuous improvements.
You have strong experience in software development and are comfortable working across the full application lifecycle, from development and deployment to monitoring and operational support.
Required skills
Software development, Java (Spring Boot)

AWS cloud platform

Azure cloud platform

DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines

Containers and cloud-native technologies

Monitoring, logging, and observability

Troubleshooting distributed systems and production issues

Automation and scripting

Git and modern software development practices

Proven experience working with:
Kubernetes

OpenTelemetry

Grafana

Who you are
You are curious, pragmatic, and comfortable working across both development and operations. You enjoy understanding how systems work in production and proactively identifying and addressing potential issues before they become problems.
You take ownership, communicate clearly when challenges arise, and enjoy collaborating with others to solve complex problems. You are also comfortable working with operational processes and ways of working, ensuring alignment with both customer requirements and internal standards.
We value individuals who are eager to learn, challenge existing ways of working, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our services.
Practical information
Assignment Type: Consulting Assignment Location: Gothenburg, Sweden  Working Model: Hybrid, with at least 2 days in the office per week Workload: Full-time (40 hours/week) Assignment Period: 30 November 2026 – 28 November 2027 Language Requirement: English (Proficient)
Applications are reviewed continuously, and the assignment may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.
We look forward to receiving your application!
If you have any questions regarding the assignment, please contact Felicia Hellström at +46 70 797 27 29 or via email at felicia@searchr.se.

As Junior Sous Chef in Newrest, your job main area of responsibility is to ensure the quality level for product and processes in the hot and cold kitchen, including SPML (special meal) preparation and canteen (staff food). Also your role is to ensure a smooth and effective staff planning in both hot and cold kitchen according to forecast, laws, and internal agreements.
Ensure an effective production in the hot and cold kitchen, fulfilling the targets for efficiency, quality, and food safety.
"Hands on" cooking with the chefs, to ensure correct level of quality and efficiency.

Main Duties & Responsibilities
·      Daily management of the employees, including time keeping
·      Short- and long-term planning of workload including hot fill and sous vide, bulk production
·      Control, and optimize work processes for better efficiency
·      Instruction and training of all groups of employees impacting the quality level in the kitchen
·      Focus on waste management, related to product throughout the whole production
·      Participate in menu presentation, where new menus are produced and presented to the customer.
·      Check new menus and rotations, before implementation
·      Ensure high level of quality and cleanliness according to service level agreements and local HACCP regulations
·      Ensure all CCP's (Critical Control Point) are captured and registered. Storing, cooking and cooling
·      Control cooking processes in Hot Fill and Sous Vide Production
·      Produce and execute chef table (show case and check the food, together with customer and commercial team).
·      Plan and execute "Top Table" (daily control of produced food, with signoff)
·      Ensure a smooth cooperation with all other departments in the unit.

Work Experience
·    Experienced in managing employees in a production setup
·    Minimum 3-4 years as a chef.
·    Preferably in-flight or related catering experience, is an advantage
·    Culinary experience from 4* or 5* hotels and/or high-level restaurants, is an advantage
 
Skills & Knowledge
·      Good interpersonal and communication skills
·      Understanding of large-scale production and assembly
·      Highly experienced with QA (Quality assurance) and hygiene processes in a production kitchen
·      Culinary understanding
·      PC user - comfortable using Microsoft Office
·      Excellent oral and written communication skills in Swedish and English language
 
Competencies to be successful in the position
·       Thinking: Information search and analysis and problem-solving skills
·       Engaging: Understanding others, team leadership and people development
·       Inspiring: Influencing and building relationships, motivating, inspiring, and communicating effectively
·       Achieving: Delivering business results under pressure, championing performance improvement and customer focus

The following are the QHSE accountabilities of all Newrest employees:
 
Follow all applicable policies and procedures required for the successful execution of the job.
Follow the QHSE Policy and meet the requirements of the organizations’ Management system in compliance with Food Safety & Quality, Occupational Health & Safety and Environmental Management System.
Ensure that all HACCP, Good Manufacturing Practices, Good Hygiene Practices, Health and Safety Procedures and Policies are followed in the department and run smoothly and consistently.
Ensure to submit all necessary quality related reports and answer or give an input to all quality related enquires on timely basis.
Ensure to take all corrections and corrective actions necessary to correct occurred non-conformities within area of responsibilities and fill necessary documentation regarding this.”

What you'll do
The Engineering Department (EN) pushes back the limits of technology so that physicists can carry out their research. Within the Electrical Engineering (EL) group of the EN department, you will join the Maintenance and Operation (MO) section, which operates and maintains CERN's electrical distribution network.

Learn more: https://videos.cern.ch/record/2301705

Your responsibilities
Contribute to the management of electrical equipment throughout its lifecycle, from procurement and installation to maintenance activities.
Manage supply contracts for low-voltage switchboards: coordinate with suppliers and follow up on orders, deliveries, warranties and after-sales services.
Prepare technical specifications and tender documents and contribute to the correspondent procurement activities.
Contribute to define and improve equipment data models in CERN's Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS), so that technical information, drawings and as-built documentation are organised and kept up to date.
Coordinate and follow up on site surveys, from data collection and verification to process and update the corresponding information in the CMMS.
Work with maintenance managers to define preventive and corrective maintenance activities in the CMMS, including maintenance task plans, standard work orders, required resources and spare parts.
Support engineers, technicians and contractors in using the CMMS through training, user guides and technical assistance.
Contribute to developing dashboards and KPIs that monitor maintenance activities, equipment performance and data quality.
Collaborate with the Asset Management team to improve and harmonise equipment data and work management processes across equipment families in the CMMS.

Your profile
Good knowledge of electrical assets such as transformers and MV/LV switchgear.
First experience with, or a strong interest in, Computerised Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS).
Good understanding of project management and procurement processes.
Familiarity with technical documentation, specifications and engineering drawings.
Your studies focused on Electrical/Industrial Engineering.

Your skills
Strong interest in electrical equipment, its lifecycle and maintenance processes.
Interest in procurement and contract management, with the ability to communicate effectively with different stakeholders and follow up on commitments.
Willingness to learn and to help improve existing methods and processes.
Structured approach to work, with strong attention to detail.
Good organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks and manage responsibilities.
Positive and collaborative attitude, with strong teamwork and communication skills.
Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Employment conditions
Work in Radiation Areas.
Interventions in underground installations.
A valid driving licence.

Be sure to meet the eligibility criteria
You are a national of a CERN Member State or Associate Member State. Currently, we cannot consider applications from Pakistani, Lithuanian, Latvian, Cypriot, Croatian and Turkish nationals, as the ceiling defined under Article II.5 of the Associate Membership Agreement has been reached.
By the application deadline, you have a maximum of 2 years of professional experience since graduation in the respective field and your highest educational qualification is either a bachelor's or master's degree. You must have a university degree and can't hold a PhD.
You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
Please pay attention to the additional criteria and requirements for this specific position and mentioned above.

You will need these documents to complete your application
Your CV (English or French)
A copy of your most relevant diploma or a certificate of achievement from your school (if you don't yet have your paper diploma)
Any document you consider relevant to your application

Jobbeskrivning
Company Story
 
Sigma Connectivity is a global tech house with all the resources needed to bring a product to market under one roof. We believe in investing in knowledge and education, making a positive impact on society and shaping a brighter future for all.
Through our core values, at Sigma Connectivity we create an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration. Our company culture promotes the freedom to explore new ideas and push the boundaries of what is possible.
Working with us means you will be working in an international environment with a diverse and inclusive atmosphere. We operate globally from 12 sites and have expert teams in North America, Sweden, Germany, Denmark, United Kingdom and Poland.
 
We are looking for a Senior System Architect!
In this role, you’ll translate client visions into robust blueprints for connected products, bridging hardware and software to define the project skeleton. As a part of the Industrialization & System Design team, you’ll own the end-to-end strategy for manufacturability, testability, and product launch—driving DFX (Design for Excellence, including DFM and DFT) directly into early PCB designs and defining test architectures from initial prototype validation through to mass production.
 
What we offer
High-Impact Engineering: Own the technical vision for complex, market-defining products from concept to high-volume manufacturing.
World-Class Team & Culture: Work alongside elite cross-functional engineers in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.
Cutting-Edge Projects: Direct access to diverse, challenging hardware and IoT projects for leading global brands.
Autonomy & Influence: High visibility and direct influence over architectural decisions, client strategies, and design-for-test practices.

Work tasks
This role focuses on the early-stage design and technical leadership of industrialization projects, ensuring that hardware and software components are optimized for production and testing.
Architecture & Strategy: Lead system architecture definitions and create comprehensive production test strategies that balance quality, yield, schedule, and cost.
Requirements Breakdown: Convert product, hardware, and quality constraints into clear specifications, including System Requirement Specifications, Production Test Requirements, and Test Implementation Specs.
DFX & Risk Management: Review hardware schematics and PCB concepts early to identify manufacturability, testability, and reliability risks, driving proactive mitigations with R&D teams.
Test Architecture Definition: Define test coverage, interfaces, embedded test functionality, fixtures, measurement methods, and factory data traceability.
Cross-Functional & Client Leadership: Drive technical discussions and balance trade-offs with customers, EMS partners, suppliers, R&D, quality, and sourcing teams.
Mentorship: Guide engineering teams on best practices in systems engineering, hardware testability, and production deployment.

We are looking for someone with
A degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, Engineering Physics, or equivalent practical background.
Proven experience working as a System Architect guiding complex electronic or embedded products from concept to production.
Proven background in production and manufacturing engineering, with strong practical experience bridging development and mass manufacturing environments.
Solid hardware depth to evaluate schematics, drive DFT/DFM improvements, and establish production test architectures alongside EMS partners.
Fluent English communication skills to present trade-offs, draft specifications, and align stakeholders

It is meritorious if you have
Experience with connected/IoT devices, wireless protocols, or embedded systems.
Exposure to end-of-line testing, RF validation, JTAG, or factory yield optimization.
Track record supporting customer proposals, SOWs, or technical pre-studies.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Supportive
Goal oriented
Social
Intellectually curious
Respectful

 
References
Reference checks are conducted as part of the recruitment process and may include both provided and independently identified professional references.

Help shape the next chapter of hospitality technology.You build your own pipeline and know how to close a deal with five stakeholders and a procurement team. You will be selling to top-tier hotel brands around the world.

At Proposales, we're transforming how hotels sell and manage Groups, Meetings & Events. We're building a modern product platform for an industry that still relies heavily on legacy systems and manual processes, helping hotels move from inquiry to booking and delivery through beautifully designed software, automation and AI.
We're now expanding beyond proposals into booking, workflows and AI-powered operations. As Senior Account Executive you'll own new business with hotel groups, luxury brands and management companies, from first outreach to signed contract. Our native two-way integration with OPERA Cloud gives you a strong story with the hotels that run it. You'll report to our Head of Sales. The role is based at our HQ in Stockholm, fully on-site.
Your mission:

Build your own pipeline through targeted outbound to hotel groups, chains and luxury brands. Expect around two-thirds of your closed deals to come from your own outreach.

Run 100+ targeted prospecting activities a week and keep 8–12 qualified opportunities moving at any time.

Own the full cycle from discovery and demo to business case, negotiation and close. Deals range from €50k to €300k ACV, with cycles of roughly four to eight months.

Multi-thread every deal across the 4–8 people involved, from C-level to GMs, Directors of Sales, Revenue, IT, Finance and Procurement.

Use a structured qualification method to keep your forecast accurate and your deals moving.

Work through security reviews, DPAs and RFPs together with our team.

Represent Proposales at industry events in Europe and our other key markets.

Share market and customer insights and learnings with product and marketing.

A bit about you:

5+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with at least 2 of those years on mid-market or enterprise accounts.

A track record of beating quota with pipeline you created yourself.

You've closed deals of €50k+ ACV with long cycles and several decision-makers and can walk us through how.

You're comfortable leading conversations with C-level executives and building a business case they sign off on.

You sell by a methodology (MEDDICC, Challenger, Command of the Message or similar) and can show us how you use it in a live deal.

You use AI daily for account research, call prep and follow-up.

Hospitality tech experience (PMS, sales & catering, CRM) or a background in hotel sales is a strong plus.

Fluent English. Another European language is a plus.

You live in Stockholm, or are ready to move here, and like working from an office with your team.

What we offer:
Real ownership. We’re expanding into new markets and beyond proposals, so you’ll help shape how we sell to enterprise, not just follow a playbook.

A proven product to sell. Proposales has been recognised as a leading RFP and proposal management solution five years in a row.

Short decision lines. You’ll work closely with leadership, and your ideas turn into action quickly.

Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission on new ARR.

A personal development and wellbeing budget to invest in yourself.

A small, international, close-knit team in our Stockholm office, with an annual meetup and regular team activities.

What we believe in:
We value ownership over process, curiosity over comfort and getting things done over getting them perfect.

Luleå University of Technology experiences rapid growth with world-leading expertise within several research areas. Our scientific and artistic research and education are conducted in close collaboration with international, national and regional companies, the public sector and leading universities. Luleå University of Technology has an annual turnover of just over SEK 2.3 billion. We have more than 1,800 employees and nearly 21,600 students.
The Machine Learning group at the Department of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineering at Luleå University of Technology is now looking for experienced students from the "Civilingenjör tillämpad Artificiell Intelligens" programme for a project focusing student retention through the mentoring and support of first year students in the programme.
 
 
You will have the opportunity to work together with other mentors and keep in contact with some senior staff, while getting the opportunity to:
Meet new people and refresh information from earlier courses
Improve your communication- and social skills
Gain leadership/mentoring experience

Job Duties
 
Typical job duties for this position will focus on tasks related to leadership and mentoring:
Organizing regular meetings with the mentee-group assigned to you, where you discuss their current challenges and questions
Having some hours set aside on a weekly basis in case one of your mentees would like to have an individual meeting/discussion
Advising students on who they can help/advise them in certain situations (if you cannot do so yourself)
Keeping in regular touch both with the mentees and other mentors

Qualifications
 
To be eligible for the position, you must be enrolled as a student in the "Civilingenjör tillämpad Artificiell Intelligens" programme of LTU. You must be in at least your second year of study and have some experience in mentoring (e.g. having had earlier meetings with the 1st year students during the first study period of the year). You are also expected to be able to take your own initiative and work independently.
 
 
It is a merit to have contributed to the programme in some capacity before (e.g. as student representative, member in Programme Council, having a role in the program association).
 
 
Terms and conditions
 
Employment as a teaching assistant is governed by Chapter 5 of the Higher Education Ordinance. Only those admitted to first- or second-cycle studies may be employed as teaching assistants (Chapter 5, Section 10 of the Higher Education Ordinance).

The role combines professional depth with meaningful business questions and room to improve the processes behind the numbers. The focus on accurate supplier accounting and responsive query handling gives the opportunity a clear mission and room to influence priorities and success measures.
The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision.
The recruitment conversation
Nordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to ask direct questions and test whether the role, mandate and partner environment are right for you.
How to apply
Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant financial process, decision or transformation you helped improve. Nordic Investin welcomes different routes into the profession and assesses evidence, judgement and potential alongside formal titles.
